syncSegmentsEn.text: There is a gift. Have you received it?
Your eyes cannot see it, but your heart will know
This gift is waiting at the door of your heart
It was prepared for you, and no one can receive it in your place
Life is finite, and time passes by
If you do not value the chance, it is hard to hold on to it
Good as the gift may be, if you do not want it
Dear friend, have you ever thought
That the child in the manger came for you?
The greatest gift is the Son of Man, the Lord Jesus
Life is finite, and time passes by
If you do not value the chance, it is hard to hold on to it
Good as the gift may be, if you do not want it
How can you receive it, how can you receive it?
